prompt: The client can fund one project and requires payback within 3 years. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Project A throws off the most cash, $3M a year
options.feedback: True, but A costs $15M, so it takes 5 years to pay back.

options.text: Project B pays back fastest, with the most cash per dollar
options.feedback: B returns $2.5M a year on $10M (4 years); C returns $2M on $6M (3 years).

options.text: C earns back its $6M in three years; A and B take longer
options.feedback: Right. Payback = investment ÷ annual cash flow: A 15 ÷ 3 = 5 years, B 10 ÷ 2.5 = 4 years, C 6 ÷ 2 = 3 years.

options.text: Project A carries the highest risk
options.feedback: The table shows money in and out, not risk.
